description: This file contains unit testing classes and methods for testing ADO.NET streaming functionalities with various relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL) within the Orleans framework. It defines test classes, configurators, and individual test cases covering different producer-consumer scenarios in streaming testing.

classes.name: SqlServerAdoNetStreamingTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET streaming tests against SQL Server.

classes.name: MySqlAdoNetStreamingTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET streaming tests against MySQL.

classes.name: PostgreSqlAdoNetStreamingTests
classes.description: Test class for ADO.NET streaming tests against PostgreSQL.

classes.name: AdoNetStreamingTests
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup, configuration, and test cases for ADO.NET streaming tests across different databases.

classes.name: TestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures silo builder with ADO.NET stream provider and storage options for testing.

classes.name: TestClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client builder with ADO.NET stream provider options for testing.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the relational storage and connection string before executing tests.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with silo and client builders.

methods.description: Test case for one producer grain and one consumer client.

methods.description: Test case for one producer client and one consumer client.

methods.description: Test case for many producer clients and many consumer grains.

methods.description: Test case for many producer clients and many consumer clients.

methods.name: StreamTest_09_ManySame_ManyProducerGrainsManyConsumerGrains
